🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive, a narrow/weak tape. VXX (1W: +14.79% | 1M: +26.07%) ABOVE TREND and SPY/TLT (1W: -3.97% | 1M: -6.04%) falling, BELOW TREND, confirm defensive pressure; the supplied regime remains CAUTION.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear rising: VXX (1W: +14.79% | 1M: +26.07%) ABOVE TREND. Credit stress rising as HYG/LQD (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -0.66%) falls, BELOW TREND; stocks lagging bonds as SPY/TLT (1W: -3.97% | 1M: -6.04%) falls, BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Tighter-leaning: UUP (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +2.83%) ABOVE TREND, reflecting a firmer dollar. Yield-curve ratio (1W: +2.38% | 1M: +0.01%) is rising, ABOVE TREND; duration preference is recovering, with TLT (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Breadth is broadly weak: 0/11 sectors positive. XLE (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -13.64%) and XLK (1W: -1.44% | 1M: -11.38%) are BELOW TREND; XLY (1W: -1.03% | 1M: +3.39%) is in CORRECTION, while tech/financials relative strength is recovering (1W: +2.00% | 1M: -12.27%). Style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US equities remain weak: SPY (1W: -2.39% | 1M: -4.96%) BELOW TREND. EEM (1W: -1.80% | 1M: -6.74%) and FXI (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -2.10%) are also BELOW TREND, while India is a relative bright spot with INDA (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +12.23%) ABOVE TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative appetite is weak: ARKK (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -15.40%) and IBIT (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -24.67%) are BELOW TREND. Small caps also lag, with IWM (1W: -2.64% | 1M: -3.63%) BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity pressure: CPER (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -13.44%) and GLD (1W: -5.64% | 1M: -9.16%) are BELOW TREND. Natural gas holds up comparatively, with UNG (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is weak: XLE (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -13.64%) BELOW TREND. Oil remains under pressure—BNO (1W: -3.41% | 1M: -20.19%) BELOW TREND—while UNG (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +2.92%) is ABOVE TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed weakness: SPY (1W: -2.39% | 1M: -4.96%) and XLK (1W: -1.44% | 1M: -11.38%) are BELOW TREND; TLT (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +0.85%) is ABOVE TREND. Cross-asset divergence favors caution, while breadth remains 0/11.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Maintain a cautious, selective stance: reduce exposure to broad equity and speculative weakness, including SPY (1W: -2.39% | 1M: -4.96%) and ARKK (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -15.40%). TLT (1W: +2.91% | 1M: +0.85%) is showing relative strength; style mixed / no clear leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth improves and relative strength persists, monitor XLY (1W: -1.03% | 1M: +3.39%) for a CORRECTION to stabilize.
BEARISH: If breadth stays at 0/11, continued weakness in XLE (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -13.64%) and XLK (1W: -1.44% | 1M: -11.38%) would reinforce caution.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If support holds, monitor UNG (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +2.92%), currently ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If selling persists, CPER (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -13.44%) and BNO (1W: -3.41% | 1M: -20.19%) remain BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor HYG/LQD at 0.7363 (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -0.66%), falling, BELOW TREND, and SPY/TLT at 8.8418 (1W: -3.97% | 1M: -6.04%), falling, BELOW TREND. Tech/financials stands at 2.9179 (1W: +2.00% | 1M: -12.27%), rising, in RECOVERY; yield-curve ratio is 1.0015 (1W: +2.38% | 1M: +0.01%), rising, ABOVE TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive, indicating narrow/weak participation. India via INDA (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +12.23%) is showing relative strength, while broad sector leadership remains unclear. Monitor rising fear in VXX (1W: +14.79% | 1M: +26.07%) and the continued divergence between equities and duration.
